title: 7-day calendar with streak reset
desc: 7-day login calendar: state resolved lazily on read (claimable / countdown / streak broken after 2 days), config-driven reward types, payload for the UI, and a paid 'skip all days' product.

title: Daily reset at 00:00 UTC
desc: Day number = os.time() // 86400; on join and every 15s it resets daily counters, refreshes the daily shop and rolls new daily tasks when the day changes (and tells TaskService if a day was missed).

title: Event-driven quests (beginner + daily)
desc: Quests progress from events (TaskService.Record(player, 'DuelWon')), beginner sets of three until finished, then three daily Core tasks; completing a set grants rewards and keeps a daily streak.

title: Login reward, codes, group/like rewards
desc: Once-per-day login reward, one-off social rewards (group checked with IsInGroup; like/favourite trusted because Roblox cannot check them), battle-pass tier claims with validation, and a case-insensitive code table saved per player.

title: Chests, playtime and achievement claims
desc: Timed chests with cooldowns and weighted loot, one-time mini chests, playtime milestones checked against session time, tiered achievements (category+tier keys), ticket shop and a weighted wheel.

title: Limited-stock codes (UpdateAsync + MemoryStore)
desc: Codes with limited stock redeemed atomically in UpdateAsync (already-redeemed / out-of-stock reasons), global codes broadcast with MessagingService and stock kept in a MemoryStore sorted map, 5s cooldown.

title: Codes stored in a DataStore (add without updating)
desc: Codes kept in a DataStore list with expiry timestamps and reward types, loaded into the server on start and refreshable, so new codes can be added without shutting servers down.

title: Simple daily chest (beginner)
desc: Standalone daily chest: its own DataStore with LastClaim/Streak, 24h cooldown, 48h streak expiry, 7-day reward table sent to the client for display, claim debounce.

title: Shared daily-gift rules (client + server)
desc: Tiny shared module: next gift id (1..7 loop), time left and canClaim from the saved {i, t} value, used by both the UI and the server check.

title: Offline earnings (capped, rate-based)
desc: Offline cash = income per second x offline seconds (capped at 12h) x boosts x a 1/6 offline rate, a gamepass multiplier and auto-collect, a 'measured earning pace' fallback, a claim-all popup endpoint, and LastLogin bookkeeping on join/leave.

title: Offline earnings (simple)
desc: Minimal offline earnings: time since last save (capped at 8h) x each placed item's income x mutation/level/rebirth/VIP multipliers, shown in a popup and paid on a Claim remote.

title: DailyRewards (streak calendar)
desc: Login calendar over a saved table: Rolling (24h + grace) or UTCDay mode, streak/best streak, loops after N days, Status() for UI countdowns, SkipWait() for a paid skip.

title: QuestTracker (event-driven quests)
desc: Quests advanced by Record(player, event, amount); beginner chain then seeded daily set (same on every server), auto or manual claim, daily streak, reset countdown.

title: CodeRedeemer (promo codes)
desc: Promo codes: normalised input, expiry, requirements, once per player in saved data, optional global use limit via UpdateAsync with roll-back, cooldown, status strings.
